Title: Wire LlamaCppInferenceNode into Mcp and Dashboard dispatch factories
Description: NodeProviderType.LlamaCpp is unhandled in the Func<NodeConfiguration, IInferenceNode> switch in both src/Orchestrator.Mcp/Program.cs and src/SplitBrain.Dashboard/Program.cs. Any nodes.json entry with Provider=LlamaCpp throws InvalidOperationException at dispatch time. Fix: add keyed LlamaCppInferenceNode singleton registration and a LlamaCpp arm to the dispatch switch in both programs, following the WorkerInferenceNode pattern.
